test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option “No replacement required”.
The soldier was known by the __sobriquete__ “Iron Hand” among his comrades.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence contains the misspelled word **"sobriquete".**
 
• **The correct spelling is "sobriquet".**
 
• The word **"sobriquet"** is a noun that means **"a nickname or a descriptive name."**
 
• For example: "He earned the sobriquet 'T
